subject: Risk reduction commitments and evidence handoff for penetration test findings
messages:
From: Aisha Gupta <aisha.gupta@acmecorp.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@acmecorp.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Request: detailed remediation ETAs + evidence for PT findings

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for taking the time today on the call. Acme's security team reviewed the pen test v3 and we need a concise remediation status for the high/critical findings so our internal risk committee can close out the ticket. Specifically we need:

- Which findings are fully remediated and deployed to prod (with timestamps).
- For in-progress fixes: owner, mitigation in place, and ETA to deploy.
- Evidence artifacts (patch diff, test results, config screenshots, audit logs) we can attach to our RCM.

Can you provide that summary by EOD Tuesday PST? If you can bundle the artifacts into one zip, that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Aisha
Aisha Gupta
Director, Security Operations
Acme Logistics
(attachment: acme_pt_summary_req.txt)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Gupta <aisha.gupta@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@acmecorp.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: detailed remediation ETAs + evidence for PT findings

Hi Aisha / Tom —

Appreciate the clear ask. Below is an itemized status for the P1/P2 findings called out in the report. We'll attach artifacts in a follow-up email once the bundle is finalized.

Summary (short):
- P1 (Privileged escalation via misconfigured service role): FIXED and deployed to prod on 2026-11-18 02:30 UTC. Post-deploy audit logs attached.
- P2 (JWT replay / session handling): Mitigation (short-term token rotation + stricter replay detection) in place; code fix in review. ETA for prod deploy: 2026-12-03.
- P3 (Insufficient request logging for admin paths): Fix scheduled, will land in 2026-11-25; ETA for evidence (log exports + dashboard screenshot): 2026-11-26.

Owner/contacts:
- P1: Karthik Iyer (on infra team) — full responsible owner; CI/CD PR merged 2026-11-17.
- P2: Soojin Lee (auth team) — patch branch open, tests failing in edge case; mitigation enforced at gateway.
- P3: Rachel Kim (platform observability) — will add structured logs and retention holiday rules.

I'll circulate the evidence zip by EOD Thursday PST (2026-11-18). If you need signatures or attestation language for SOC2 evidencing, flag here and we'll include.

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Sales Engineering (acting as SRE coordinator)
Redwood Inference
(attachment: none)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Aisha Gupta <aisha.gupta@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@acmecorp.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 02:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: detailed remediation ETAs + evidence for PT findings

Aisha — quick technical note on P1 (priv escalation):

What we changed: the service role used by the inference autoscaler had a wildcard IAM binding that allowed token exchange for admin-scoped ops. We removed the wildcard binding and introduced a scoped role with least privilege.

Evidence included in attached zip:
- iam-policy-before-after.diff (shows removal of wildcard)
- ci-cd-deploy-20261117.log (successful deploy)
- audit-trace-20261118.txt (token exchange rejected after fix)

Impact and verification: We ran replay attempts and verified that privileged endpoints return 403 for token types that previously succeeded. Post-fix regression suite passed.

(attachment: remediation_evidence_bundle_20261118.zip)

-karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Infra Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Gupta <aisha.gupta@acmecorp.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@acmecorp.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: detailed remediation ETAs + evidence for PT findings

Hi Aisha —

Follow-up on P2 (JWT replay / session handling):

Short-term mitigation:
- We deployed a token rotation policy at the gateway (30s cache TTL for bearer tokens used for control plane interactions) on 2026-11-16. This reduces replay window and is already active.

Code fix status:
- PR #784 (auth/session: replay-detection) pushed 2026-11-18; currently failing two integration tests around concurrent refresh. Expected green by 2026-11-29.
- ETA for prod rollout (including canary): 2026-12-03 (conservative to allow test/monitoring ramp).

Planned evidence to provide: patch diff (jwt_fix_patch.diff), integration test run (ci-integration-20261119.txt), canary metrics snapshot post-deploy.

Let me know if Acme wants a short runbook for manual mitigation steps; we can provide one.

Soojin
Soojin Lee
Auth Team Lead
Redwood Inference

Aisha —

Attached is the evidence bundle as discussed. Contents overview:
- pen_test_report_v3.pdf (original report for reference)
- remediation_evidence_bundle_20261118.zip (includes iam-policy-before-after.diff, ci-cd logs, audit traces, canary metrics)
- jwt_fix_patch.diff (patch file for the JWT replay fix)

Short summary for your risk committee:
- P1 (priv escalation) — Remediated and verified 2026-11-18. Closed for remediation.
- P2 (JWT replay) — Mitigated at gateway; full code fix targeted for 2026-12-03. We recommend acceptance of mitigation with final validation post-deploy.
- P3 (admin logging) — In progress; ETA evidence 2026-11-26.

If you need an official attestation for SOC2 evidence packages, Madison (Legal) can prepare a short signed letter — ping me and I'll loop her in.

Thanks for patience; please reply here if anything else is needed for your audit.

Best,
Hannah
